content.value: Roshni is a licensed C. A. During the first month of operations of her firm, the (35) following transactions occurred:
June-2 Hired a secretary- receptionist at a salary of TK 10,000 per month.
June-3 Office rent paid in cash TK 9,000.
June-4 Stationary goods purchased in cash for office use TK 12,000.
June-15 Completed a tax assignment billed client TK 25,000 for services provided on account.
June-17 Received cash of TK 22,000 for services completed.
June-28 Paid secretary- receptionist TK 10,000 salary for the month.
June-30 Cash received from client for transaction June 15.
Required: Prepare necessary ledger accounts and balance show in to trial balance.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
